brief.concept: A concise social introduction to Propeller Picks: what it is, how its AI player-prop research works, what makes it different, and how to read its public historical record responsibly.
brief.primary_question: What is Propeller Picks, how is it different from a typical picks service, and what proof can a new user inspect?
brief.audience: Sports fans and DFS or pick'em users seeing Propeller for the first time on X/Twitter.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers understand that Propeller is a free, inspectable AI player-prop research platform—not a sportsbook or promise machine—and know where to start.
brief.cta: Try the free Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Use a current public Analyzer capture and current Results page data. Historical archive figures must carry the dated, non-ROI limitation; do not call the archive a forward-tested win rate.
